runtime_uncertainties: Eight unselected exact primary/fallback bundles pass pinned offline CPU tests; original Native spawn, crossing path and body motion remain unverified.
Three fallback thresholds have separate source-hashed synthetic crossings; original Native trigger observations and source pixels remain unverified.

Two 240-frame synthetic saved positives, six negatives and eight v1 portable package positive/negative proofs pass; selected strict v2 compatibility and independent delivery acceptance remain unproved.
Actual practicability of right-half movement and legal judgment require original context; no numeric legal surrogate is authorized.

evidence_review.method: Review frozen assignment, low-confidence conditional crossing witness, empty full-train membership and absent accepted-recording inventory

gaps.why_existing_insufficient: No accepted recording is listed. The authored 1.3 m lateral diagnostic shows requested geometry, not an original right-half passage or whether right-half movement was practicable.

The conditional witness requires a marked highway crosswalk connected to the alley route, associated controls, passage space, obstacles and other pedestrians. These are not established by accepted Native evidence.
